requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4770-5060--228.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
4399-4770-5060--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Cemetery Prowler.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5060--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1286-6495-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
1286-6495-6888.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5147-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5147-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5147-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

5641-6824-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6824-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

876-5845-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Orochi Merge-Keeper.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Orochi Merge-Keeper from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6000-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

1494-3340-7363.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
1494-3340-7363.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, creating five Treasure tokens and five Mutagen tokens due to Donatello.
Activate the five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate the five Mutagens by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing them, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1170-5195-7525.description:
Cast a copy of Striking Palette from exile by paying {R}, unpreparing Pigment Wrangler.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist both trigger. If you have reached Step 9, each delayed Striking Palette trigger from the previous iteration also goes on the stack.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Pigment Wrangler, which enters prepared.
Resolve a Striking Palette trigger if it exists, copying Striking Palette and causing Storm-Kiln Artist to trigger.
Resolve a Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve a copy of Striking Palette, creating a delayed trigger to copy the next instant or sorcery cast this turn.
Repeat steps 4-6 until the stack is empty.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5231-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4217-6556-7101.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4217-6556-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-4460-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4460-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1169-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

413-628-7212.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Creakwood Safewright enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2433-2558-4139-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters, Rosie and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Rosie trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter token.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-3585-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-4222-6006.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

224-225-1671-3314-3430.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-225-1671-3314-3430.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-6475-6797.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2457-4094-4785.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-4094-4785.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

850-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
850-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
850-4067-5672.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-2279-4321-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2279-4321-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1651-2750-4321-5251.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

1238-2351-2511-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

751-2499-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}.
751-2499-3821.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.

1142-1429-2034-5570.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Lesser Masticore if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Nardole otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Lesser Masticore, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

129-1562-5137.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-1562-5137.notes: Morphling can be in any zone so long as Machine God's Effigy is on the battlefield as a copy of it.

4013-4151-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Vishgraz.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mites, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1020-1117-2906-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1020-1117-2906-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding one mana of any color.
Junk Diver dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

1424-2335-2744.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2335-2744.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

3525-3809-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3809-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

1306-1329-3338-3721.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1306-1329-3338-3721.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thermal Navigator by sacrificing Mana Crypt, giving Thermal Navigator flying until end of turn.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing yourself to cast Mana Crypt from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When you cast Mana Crypt, Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Mana Crypt resolves.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may repeat the loop targeting any castable artifact card in your graveyard in step 3 each time.
You may also skip step 2 to leave your artifacts on the battlefield, or you may sacrifice Thermal Navigator in step 2 and recast it in step 4 for infinite ETB, LTB, sacrifice, and death triggers.
